description: Published proof generation/verification benchmark thresholds for Harpocrates. CI enforces the `ci` and `revocation_ci` targets against synthetic envelopes. Native/browser ceilings bound real UltraHonk prove/verify on operator hardware within bench.lock timeouts, including revocation_witness at MAX_REVOCATION_WITNESS_DEPTH=16 (65536 leaves). Reports never include witness, proof hex, or secrets — only timings, sizes, and digests. See docs/zk-benchmarks.md.

calibrated_from.ci: synthetic driver (deterministic envelope); headroom for runner jitter
calibrated_from.native: host CLI UltraHonk within zk/bench/bench.lock.json native.timeout_ms
calibrated_from.browser: Node/bb.js UltraHonk within browser.timeout_ms (Evidence Studio worker stack)
calibrated_from.soroban_adjacent: host CPU/memory budget envelope for register_anonymous_verified / classify
calibrated_from.revocation_ci: synthetic driver for revocation_witness at depth=16 (65536 leaves)
calibrated_from.revocation_native: host CLI UltraHonk for revocation_witness at depth=16 within revocation_native.timeout_ms
calibrated_from.revocation_browser: Node/bb.js UltraHonk for revocation_witness at depth=16 within revocation_browser.timeout_ms

rollback: Delete this file to make compare inert (exit 0). No protocol or proof-format migration.

privacy.note: Thresholds are numeric only. Forbidden report keys remain enforced by zk_bench.assert_privacy_safe.

ci.description: Hermetic CI gate (synthetic prove/verify). Must stay green without nargo/bb.

native.description: Host nargo/bb prove+verify. Caps sit under native.timeout_ms=180000.

browser.description: Node/bb.js UltraHonk (browser-equivalent). Caps sit under browser.timeout_ms=180000.

soroban_adjacent.description: Soroban-adjacent host budget envelope (verify phase only).

revocation_ci.description: Hermetic CI gate for revocation_witness at MAX_REVOCATION_WITNESS_DEPTH=16 (65536 leaves).

revocation_native.description: Host nargo/bb prove+verify for revocation_witness at MAX_REVOCATION_WITNESS_DEPTH=16 (65536 leaves).

revocation_browser.description: Node/bb.js UltraHonk browser proving baseline for revocation_witness at MAX_REVOCATION_WITNESS_DEPTH=16 (65536 leaves).
